title: Convalt Energy — Lesotho Kobong hydropower & AI data centre, binding Memorandum of Agreement, 4 June 2026
description:
At least **1,200MW** of renewable pumped-storage hydropower in the **Kobong region, Mokhotlong District**, with an integrated green-powered **AI data centre**. A wider partnership announced alongside extends to approximately **4.6GW of solar** (ground-mounted and floating) and up to **4GWh of battery storage** — these sit outside the M98bn agreement figure. Construction targeted for **2029**, subject to mandatory feasibility studies which Convalt is expected to fund. The Lesotho project company is expected to sit within **Convalt International**, a proposed entity to hold Convalt's international assets.

Scale, for context, as reported: Lesotho's installed generation capacity is about **72MW** and domestic demand about **209MW**; in 2024 it imported **438 GWh** of **970 GWh** consumed, chiefly from Eskom and Mozambique. At 1,200MW the project would cover domestic demand and leave roughly **991MW** for export.

title: World Bank — Lesotho Public Sector Foundations for Service Delivery Project, 2024
description:
"PROPOSED CREDIT IN THE AMOUNT OF SDR 9.1 MILLION (US$12 MILLION EQUIVALENT) TO THE KINGDOM OF LESOTHO FOR A PUBLIC SECTOR FOUNDATIONS FOR SERVICE DELIVERY PROJECT" (Report No. PAD00149, December 22, 2023). "The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to strengthen expenditure controls and improve delivery of selected digital public services."

Components as costed in the PAD data sheet: "Expenditure management strengthening 3,300,000.00 Human resource management and organizational transformation 2,200,000.00 Shared digital government foundations 5,000,000.00 Reform coordination and project management support 1,500,000.00". "Component 3. Shared digital government foundations (US$ 5 million equivalent). This component will put in place an enabling environment to support digital transformation and a shared DPI, improve coordination and data exchange between and within minist[ries]".

Implementing agencies: "Ministry of Finance and Development Planning, Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation, Ministry of Public Service".
